diffs.diff: clear channel irradiance (mW/cm2): datasheet reading gives 0.04237 per count, the part's model has 1, 1, 1, 1, 1
diffs.evidence: The APDS-9960 datasheet RGBC Characteristics table (VDD = 3 V, TA = 25 C, AGAIN = 16x) lists 'Clear channel irradiance responsivity 18.88 / 23.60 / 28.32 counts/(mW/cm2), Neutral white LED, l = 560 nm'. 0.04237 is just 1/23.60, a typical characterisation figure valid only at 16x gain under that light source (min-max spread +/-20%, and it scales with AGAIN and ATIME). It is not a register conversion. The chip's CDATA/RDATA/GDATA/BDATA registers (0x94-0x9B) and PDATA (0x9C) hold raw ADC counts ('Full scale ADC count value 65535 counts'; proximity 'Full scale ADC counts 255'). The part models them as raw counts (unit 'counts', scale 1), and the driver's color_raw() returns raw counts. So the model is right, and the second reading's figure is a different, light-source- and gain-dependent unit.
